title: Iran's Army Spokesman Says Enemy Weaknesses Identified During War, Combat Confidence Increased
text:
Iran's Army Spokesman Says Enemy Weaknesses Identified During War, Combat Confidence Increased"
" "
"🔆🔅TEHRAN - Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia, Iran's Army Spokesman, made the remarks."
" "

"SOT1, Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia, Iran's Army Spokesman (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:38): "We gained valuable experience, identified where the enemy’s weaknesses lie and what they are, and significantly increased our confidence in confronting the enemy. We also used new equipment, which, if necessary, will be made public at the appropriate time. This includes equipment in both the defensive and offensive domains, missiles and drones, which will be unveiled in due course.""
" "
"SOT2, Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia, Iran's Army Spokesman (Farsi) (00:39 - 01:00): "The [military] equipment was being produced on a daily basis throughout the war. Today, too, we have continued production with intensity and determination, and a large stockpile of this equipment is currently available to the Islamic Republic of Iran’s Army. The Army is fully prepared in terms of equipment.
